comparison.objective: Select and turn a cabinet hinge's side-adjust cam, verify even closed-door gaps, and avoid harmful decoy screws.
comparison.physical_skill: Acquire and engage a slotted screwdriver, identify the correct cam, apply rotary adjustment, close the door and inspect reveals; no translational supported transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Requires even 3–6 mm reveals, at most 1 mm difference, flush closure and release, with zero for latched hinge sag; candidate instead requires mated parallel support, full block transfer and zero ball loss.
comparison.reason: This tests diagnostic screw selection, rotary tool engagement and visual adjustment of door geometry. The candidate tests bimanual physical bridging and containment of freely simulated rolling elements. Its missing numeric transfer tolerances do not undermine this clear mechanism and outcome distinction.
